datePolicy: Original access/test date 2026-11-06 Asia/Singapore retained; original execution and archive timestamps also fall on 2026-11-05 UTC. Global source-list access date retained for cited URLs; exact per-fetch timestamps remain in source-access.json. Unknown original run model stays unknown. Localization is not a source refresh, price quotation, compatibility audit or new test. No publication date invented.
uncertainties: No images were uploaded, no external image-understanding or cloud calls were used, no accounts were created, and no personal photographs were tested. Inbound software, weights, text documentation and source-image downloads were required; provisioning was not offline.
Network denial applies to timed process trees and sandboxed OCR; a negative loopback socket check is not a full-machine packet audit or proof that sync, backup and background apps were isolated.

Six prepared cases use three public-domain/CC0 source photographs, two local graphics and a repeated forest JPEG stress crop. The historical scan and forest were already JPEG reproductions; references are not pristine originals or historical facial ground truth.

Second serial pass reported, one measurement per tool/image; first pass was functionality evidence. Warm caches and uncontrolled shared-machine load remain. Medians mix different sizes; peak RAM unmeasured. Download, installation, metrics, OCR and crop-generation time excluded.

No human or cloud-vision viewing claimed. Crop MAE, Laplacian detail ratio and local-range deviation are numerical proxies, not recovered-detail percentages or hallucination detectors. Haar detection only locates a face; no identity fidelity test.

Tesseract is a fallible local supplementary check, not a human transcription score. All enlarged text outputs failed consequential price/identifier recognition; even reference OCR misread the smallest diagnostic line. Best image similarity does not establish correct words.

Only specified small/standard models and settings were tested on Apple M2. No TTA, per-image tuning, face enhancement, Upscayl GUI, EDSR, anime-model evaluation, real-scratch restoration or colourisation validation.

Real-ESRGAN wrapper MIT and upstream BSD-3-Clause are distinct; no separate bundled-weights-only licence was found. FSRCNN repository explicitly includes pretrained models under Apache-2.0 but no separate weights-only notice was located. waifu2x owner confirms MIT weights; exact ncnn conversion lineage not independently traced.

Source list calls Pillow HPND-style; archived Pillow notice labels it MIT-CMU. Both labels are disclosed rather than silently replacing the original. Repository licences do not independently clear all training-image or output-use rights.
LOC catalog fetch was blocked by verification; indexed primary metadata and archived Commons mapping corroborated portrait date and exact JPEG. Alternate portrait file not found was not used.

Local package evidence is not a public download or portable installer. New Macs may require normal per-app approval and executable permissions; no global Gatekeeper change was made. Model file bytes are not RAM.
editingContract: Local English and Simplified Chinese Markdown/data drafts with generated HTML previews; retain all 24 measured rows with PSNR, SSIM, processing/end-to-end time and ROI proxies, numeric/date/URL and corresponding table-cell parity, source rights, licensing and privacy boundaries. Use the shared build/check tools. No Review, AggregateRating, stars, publication, website-repository changes, external research, image-model calls or benchmark rerun.
